name: yi-sdlc
description: Yaroslav's user-level Claude Code kit for Windows: the full SDLC pipeline (the sdlc plugin by Kyrylo Genkov, imported under the yi-sdlc namespace: 21 skills and 11 agents from map-architecture and interview to ship-feature), YouTrack ticket skills (impl-fix, impl-change, impl-feature) driven by a per-repo profile and run in parallel Rider tabs, commit conventions, a desktop dialog for Claude's questions, and toast notifications.
